budgets.renderPolicy: Cull outside viewport plus 32 world units. Use cached alpha patches, no per-frame full-screen lighting pass. Shed ambient motes first under pressure; keep enemy tells, posts and aura indicators. Freeze decorative sway with reduced motion.
budgets.measure: Replay the same featured-seed route for 30 active seconds at both viewports, with three runs each for 1.6 and 1.69 on the same recorded host, DPR and throttling profile. Save frame trace and report raw values.
